name: marketing_skills_for_ai_agents
description: A collection of marketing capabilities designed for Claude Code and AI agents, covering CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.

inputs.name: marketing_data
inputs.description: Data sets or inputs relevant to marketing tasks such as website analytics, copy drafts, SEO keywords, or growth metrics.

inputs.name: marketing_goals
inputs.description: Specific objectives to be achieved, e.g., improve conversion rate, optimize SEO rankings, or enhance copy effectiveness.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: Textual content that requires copywriting, editing, or SEO optimization.

outputs.name: optimized_content
outputs.description: Copywriting or SEO-enhanced content tailored to marketing goals.

outputs.name: analytics_report
outputs.description: Insights and metrics derived from marketing analytics data.

outputs.name: growth_strategy
outputs.description: Recommended approaches and engineering techniques for marketing growth.

patterns: Growth engineering processes integrating AI agents
steps: Input marketing data and define specific marketing goals.
Analyze content and existing analytics data for performance gaps.
Generate improved marketing copy or SEO enhancements based on analysis.
Produce analytics reports highlighting actionable insights.
Formulate growth strategies leveraging engineering principles and AI capabilities.
Deploy or integrate the generated output with Claude Code or AI agents.
use_cases: Improving website conversion rates using AI-driven CRO tactics.
Generating SEO-rich marketing copy for campaigns.
Analyzing marketing data and generating actionable reports.
Developing growth strategies powered by AI assistance.
Automating marketing content optimization workflows with Claude Code.

prompt_templates.name: seo_optimization
prompt_templates.template: Optimize the following content for SEO with keywords: {keywords}. Content: {content}

prompt_templates.name: conversion_rate_optimization
prompt_templates.template: Analyze this marketing page content and suggest improvements to increase conversion rate: {content}

prompt_templates.name: analytics_report_generation
prompt_templates.template: Generate an analytics performance report based on this data: {marketing_data}

prompt_templates.name: growth_strategy_development
prompt_templates.template: Suggest a growth engineering strategy for these marketing goals: {marketing_goals}

prompt_templates.name: marketing_copywriting
prompt_templates.template: Write compelling marketing copy focused on {target_audience} to promote {product_or_service}.
